`key.TEST-KEY-1.json` is a keystore that the **Rust** `pqagent init --test-seed 1` wrote, encrypted with the passphrase in `test/keystore.test.ts`. It holds the repo's public TEST key 1 (seed = keccak256("EmpowerTours test agent seed " || 0x01), the same key as agent 1 in every proved fixture). It is not a secret. It is here so CI can check that the TS SDK decrypts Rust keystores (Argon2id + ChaCha20-Poly1305).
